reviews.title: So slow
reviews.text: The app is so slow and loading takes forever. Every time I tap something the delay in response is crazy long. I’m applying filters and not seeing them working also. Very difficult to use.

reviews.title: Woke
reviews.text: Why the first thing I see when I open this app in the App Store is a picture of two women getting married. Enough with the woke agenda. No need to mainstream it

reviews.title: The cash funds are a bit pointless for any honeymoon related items
reviews.text:
It takes a week for any money in the cash funds to show up to even be available to transfer, and after that another 5-7 business days to reflect on your bank statement.. so if you get money day of the wedding for the honeymoon fund or things to do on the honeymoon (romantic dinner, couples massage, etc) the money probably won’t be available for your actually honeymoon. If I could do it again, I’d only leave the Venmo option open. Would have been nice to know before hand. 

I also found the wedding planning aspect to just be okay. I’m sure it fine for big weddings, but other than letting people know we wanted monetary gifts, I don’t feel like it served a huge purpose for my planning. Adding a photo album function for guests to add photos would be a nice add on.

reviews.title: Needs a lot of work
reviews.text: Spams with too many marketing notifications. The messaging guests feature is also buggy and needs an overhaul. The website works, but the app needs significant fixes.

reviews.title: No save the date samples?
reviews.text: I had ordered 3 free save the date samples back in June. My fiance and I wanted to see how they would come out before we decided on which one we wanted to edit and order. We still have not received the save the date samples and we are almost in October. This made me very nervous to even go forward with using this site because if it’s still almost 4 months since we ordered SAMPLES then how long would it actually take to receive the actual order if we just decided based off a picture on the site? We don’t want to risk not getting anything in time to then send everything out in time. They also don’t have a whole lot of options for gothic weddings and they really should. I wouldn’t recommend this site to any of my friends to use. Timing is very crucial when trying to plan out an entire wedding on your own.

reviews.title: Worst app
reviews.text: Do not use this app. It is janky, difficult for guests to navigate and CONSTANTLY has tech issues. Trash. Use Zola instead. This app made everything extremely difficult.

reviews.title: Nope - anything else
reviews.text:
I had a terrible experience with his whole platform website and app. It consistently failed in connecting the Amazon registry and most of the people had a terrible time getting the website to work. I would recommend you do everything on your own and just connect registries to the store you like in controller on your own.

Update: they reached out to me to assist - but to little too late - the last two times I reached out to them - before I was married (I have now been married for over a month)- they had no solutions and offered nothing as a compensation or apology. Why would I reach out for a third time now that they see this review? 🤷‍♀️ just so I have to wait days for a response or use the chat bot - I’m good thanks.

It still won't let me in. I deleted and re downloaded it and now it's saying I can't get in at all 😭😭 I feel like there's gotta be easier sites compared to an app that hardly works

reviews.title: Slow and filters don’t work

reviews.title: Website makes no sense
reviews.text:
We spent a lot of time adding people’s guests for our wedding. When people scan the QR code from our invitations, no one can see the guests we added for the invitees, so everyone is adding in their own guests and messing up the count or they are getting error messages saying to try again later.  Dry disappointed in what we thought had to be a good way of doing this. Turns out, it would have better to use devote or just text our invites. Anything would be better than this has been. We have to go in every time someone RSVP’s and make the corrections.

A big problem is the guest does not see their guest we added for them, but they see a big bottom that says add a guest?????
Terrible way of doing g this, pick any other method than the knot!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Misogyny
reviews.text: Welcome to 1955 ladies! This app is just for you, as there is no feature to let your fiance join the planning. You will be the project manager and sole employee. Your fiance won’t even be able to see what’s happening unless they log into your account. This is not a small glitch, the entire app is built on the premise that the woman would do all of the wedding planning. It takes so many hours of labor to throw an event like this 😫😫😫 But sure, after you make him a sandwich, go ahead and squeeze in the 400-600 hours needed to plan a wedding. You don’t have a career, so that should be a real joy for you

reviews.title: It’s good until it isn’t
reviews.text: On the Phone app, there is no tutorial on how to do anything, so I had to redo a lot of things because they were out of order. I put them in one place and then realized they needed to go in a different place. And it feels like it tripled my time that it should have taken. Also, I spent a lot of time googling where to find things or how to properly do them which was more time spent completing the task.

reviews.title: Awful website

reviews.title: You get what you (don’t) pay for

I’m having to individually text people if they’re coming because they are telling me they submitted their response but I can’t see them on my end. And they say you can upload excel lists but what they mean is individually copy and paste each line manually from a spreadsheet. I would never recommend this app or site EVER!

reviews.title: Poo poo doo doo
reviews.text: Were you hoping for a app That’s constantly glitching and won’t let you update anything? Well that’s what you get here. But you’ve already set up your account and put hours and hours into it so you’re gonna have keep it..

reviews.title: Lack of communication especially when timing is a factor
reviews.text:
I would not recommend this wedding planning website based on my experience. Planning a wedding extremely time, sensitive, and communication with vendors is critical. Unfortunately, when something goes wrong with your account to support and follow up for incredibly disappointing. Our account was suddenly locked without a clear explanation, leaving us, unable to communicate with our vendor or continue planning. Instead of receiving prompt assistance we were simply told that tech services will look into it, but no one could tell us when the issue actually be resolved . There is no sense of urgency, no update and no proactive communication. as a couple trying to plan a wedding on a strict timeline, this has been incredibly stressful. We shouldn’t have to chase down customer support, repeatedly asked for updates, or do all the work ourselves just to get the basic assistance.
A company that serves engaged couples should understand how important timing communication are. At the very least they provide timely. Follow up with Email to keep customers informed throughout the process. I have reached out to customer service on my own account and have only told that tech services will fix it and that’s it.

reviews.title: Do Not Recommend
reviews.text: The Knot was great during the initial planning stages, but I ended up having several issues with my RSVPs, Registry, and the app itself right before my wedding date. When I tried to get help, I got stuck in a loop with their chat bot. I wish I had gone with a different platform.

reviews.title: Can’t send digital save the dates or invitations
reviews.text: Good website but you can’t send custom messages or digital invites to guests if you wanted to which I think is crazy

reviews.title: Gifting is ridiculous
reviews.text: You can’t actually track gifts on your way to your address. It led to my package going missing. Cherry on top is that customer service is useless.

reviews.title: Ok app, some features don’t work
reviews.text: Style quiz won’t update

reviews.title: Not easy to navigate
reviews.text: Lots of great vendors to connect with. However, the functionality and accessibility of this site are not user friendly. For how long The Knot has been around, I would have thought they would have a better system.

reviews.title: Don’t Use
reviews.text: First of all, the app had issues multiple times throughout our engagement (wouldn’t show chat history or messages, etc). Sometimes this would last a couple of days. Second of all,  they would ONLY show the same vendors over and over and over again. I went to an alterations person off of their “high award winning recommendation” and was body shamed and called fat by the owner. I wrote the review on the app, and they refused to publish it because I didn’t have the shaming in writing (but in reality it was because they had given her multiple awards and receive payment). Seriously, save yourself the headache.

reviews.title: So frustrating
reviews.text: This app is the glitchiest, most frustrating, non responsive app. I can’t possibly imagine using a more migraine inducing app while trying to plan a wedding.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Over complicated in a bunch of nonsense you don’t need, and missing ease or options all of the critical data you do need!!!  Go to Zola or Wedding Wire instead. This app is THE WORST.

reviews.title: Non-functional
reviews.text:
This app is effectively useless. It freezes constantly on the newest iPad, and the navigation is unintuitive. Venues are displayed full screen with no display options, and links to different sections just redirect to the home page (Travel > Best of Registry). 

It’s a shame the app is so bad, it would be nice not to have to break out a computer.

reviews.title: Wedding Website - Why Can’t I Choose the Elements for Each Page?
reviews.text: I love the Knot overall as a tool and would give it a higher rating, but the wedding website building is lacking in options and glitch-y. The biggest frustration is not being able to choose the types of elements you want for each page. For example, I can’t put a Location element on the Schedule page - only on a very limited # of pages. It makes no sense why I can’t customize the page and add other element types. Please update this!!!

reviews.title: So glitchy
reviews.text: There hasn’t been one time that I’ve opened this app and it hasn’t had a bug. Sometimes it’s with my website, other times I cant scroll down the page, or it asks me if I want to delete something I didn’t even click on. I’m so tired of this.

reviews.title: actually super inconvenient
reviews.text: i actually dont know how this app has such high reviews. you can’t send custom messages, and it’s difficult to create a set, ACCURATE list of recipients to send updates to (for example: the reception was invite only and sending that invitation out was very very difficult & still didn’t go out as it should’ve) also, when you’re sending updates, it just looks like the recipient is being asked to rsvp all over again instead of highlighting updates made to the website or info regarding the event. notes left for the recipients to see as they rsvp were not shown & there’s a glitch with the headcount. there’s more small but super inconvenient issues. hated the experience.

reviews.title: All of the important functions don’t work
reviews.text: I love that this site is free and offers so much amazing help to plan a wedding. The frustrating thing is that the app will not let you view your guest list, RSVPs, or who has purchased anything from your registry. It is supposed to allow those functions, but it has been saying “please refresh” for about 9 months. I have offloaded and reloaded the site several times and so has my fiancée. It won’t work on either of our phones.

reviews.title: Soooo User unfriendly
reviews.text: There is no reason for a reputable company to have such bad app. Constantly crashing, poor navigation, bad app foundation.

reviews.title: Pictures
reviews.text: The picture quality of anything you upload is terrible and they all look blurry!

reviews.title: Registry
reviews.text: So frustrating to use this website in general but linking the registry is one of the most annoying things I have ever experienced. I linked my registry from Anthropologie and every single thing was switched to the base color. There is no way to update it on the Knot and it is still correct on Anthropologie. I have no idea how to fix it and I have refreshed it at least 5 times to no avail. I would absolutely not recommend the Knot as a wedding planning service after this. I should have picked Zola
